cachedEvaluationDecision.note: The cached 45-recording experiment and all measurements remain unchanged. The later production acceptance below adds independent integration evidence; it does not turn cached replay into new inference.

productionAcceptance.scope: Narrow local timing fallback plus tested integration
limitations: The final English lexical WER is 2351/6237 (37.6944043611%), compared with historical v1 2257/6237 (36.1872695206%): 94 more word errors. Source audio hashes match, but model-runtime/seed effects were not causally isolated.
The same-native legacy control has 2367 word errors; the final adapter has 16 fewer. This controlled adapter comparison does not erase the historical end-to-end regression.

English exact timed-word coverage is 3532/5693 (62.0411031091%), versus 1966/5693 for the rejected whole-line fallback and 3753/5693 for the current same-native legacy control. The remaining control gap is 221 timed words.

Timing acceptance uses 3523 common correctly matched words: start MAE changes from 0.2584152241s to 0.2584719939s and end MAE is unchanged to floating-point precision. Different-coverage aggregate MAEs must not be interpreted as accuracy gains.

All 45 cached texts are identical to the conservative lexical baseline. All 15 instrumentals have zero lexical words, but one has an ellipsis-only line. These results do not guarantee the absence of future hallucinations.
The span policy was evaluated on exposed data. There is no independent vocal holdout, no human-verified Ukrainian/Russian accuracy score, and no labeled full-song vocal chord evaluation.
Uncertain timing remains approximate at span level. The single final real service inference validates integration and output reproducibility, not all 45 final-profile model executions.
No public shared service deployment, physical Android run, or APK build is represented by this acceptance.
